facts.fact: The health ministry's SNIS procedures manual states that DHIS2 was adopted as the national integrated platform for SNIS data and scaled up to all health facilities in the country from 2018; the facilities it names as entering reports are USP, private facilities (EPS), CHP, CHR and CHU.

The manual (April 2022) requires each health facility (USP, EPS, CHP, CHR, CHU) to key its own validated monthly and quarterly activity reports (RMA/RTA), compiled from paper registers, into DHIS2 before the 5th of the following month and also to send a paper copy to the prefectoral health directorate (DPS), which validates the entries in DHIS2 by the 20th.

The manual (April 2022) places coordination of the SNIS under the health ministry's Direction du Système National d'Information Sanitaire et de l'Informatique (DSNISI), whose national SNIS pool is charged with maintaining and updating DHIS2.

The manual states that the ministry has a strategic plan for strengthening the SNIS (PSSNIS/PSRSNIS) for 2018-2022, aligned to the PNDS 2017-2022 and following a first plan for 2013-2017, and that DHIS2 was adopted as the national platform in the context of that plan.
The manual (April 2022) names no budget line for the SNIS or DHIS2; it lists seeking partners to finance the SNIS among the duties of both the regional and the national SNIS pools.
